channel.title: Open Sangam Articles
channel.description: Long-form essays about Open Sangam, Sangam literature, Tamil language technology, and AI.

item.title: AI for Tamil: Neural Machine Translation and LLMs
item.description: Exploring the challenges and breakthroughs in building large language models and neural translators specifically optimized for Tamil's rich morphology.

item.title: Bridging the Digital Divide: AI Initiatives for Indic Languages
item.description: An overview of multi-lingual model training, tokenization issues, and open-source consortia like AI4Bharat pushing the boundaries of Indic AI.
item.author: P. R. Krishnan

item.title: Computational Linguistics and Morphological Analysis of Tamil
item.description: Understanding how computational morphology, POS tagging, and syntactic parsing are applied to agglutinative languages like Tamil.
item.author: Dr. T. Vasudevan

item.title: Preserving the Palm Leaves: Digital Archives of Classical Tamil
item.description: Analyzing the curation, digitisation, OCR processing, and preservation of ancient Tamil manuscripts and palm-leaf records.
item.author: S. Meenakshi

item.title: A History and Evolution of Tamil Language Technology
item.description: From early character encodings like TSCII and TAB to Unicode compliance and modern natural language processing toolkits for Tamil.
item.author: M. Anbarasan

item.title: Beyond Translation: The Future of Tamil AI and Cultural Tech
item.description: Speculating on the next decade of Tamil AI, from voice interfaces and interactive agents to multimodal models interpreting ancient heritage.
item.author: Open Sangam Research Group
